page.overview:
Who is Viper Pilot?

Early on, Cobra realized that in order to beat G.I. Joe, they will need infantrymen with specific specialties that regular Cobra Troopers could not provide. Thus, the Viper Pilot force was created to fill the need for airborne capable troops.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Viper Pilot was included in the 1983 edition of A Real American Hero toys. He was included with the Viper glider. ---- Appearance: blue helmet, shirt, gloves, and pants; black face-mask, straps, kneepads, and boots; silver Cobra insignia on chest ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/83/viperpilot.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/83/viperpilot.shtml Filecard]
